findings.problem: The ru style guide's Width rules name the accepted abbreviations ('мин', 'сек'; 'настр.' only if a wave records it). 'псевд.' is a standard dictionary abbreviation, so recording it is not required, but it is not documented.
findings.suggestion: Keep the value. When convenient, add 'alias → «псевдоним»; «псевд.» in width-constrained facts lines' to the ru style guide's Width rules (the translator already proposes this). Non-gating.

tui.app.notes: Placeholder: message_arguments is (('aliases','simple'),) in both en and ru. One key; valid JSON; the only Cf/Zs/Cc character is a plain U+0020 space, so no bidi or format characters. Accuracy: 'псевд.' = 'псевдоним(ы)'. It is number-neutral, so it fits the en singular 'alias' for any count of names. The term matches tui.team_authoring.aliases 'псевдонимы' and aliases_hint, and ru catalogues already abbreviate this way ('сохр.'). I agree with rejecting 'алиасы': it is dev slang, and the guide prefers the settled Russian term; it is the same width, so width does not favour it. Readability: 'N участников · псевд.: lop' parses unambiguously. Width (rich cell_len; ru member_count rendered via render_message): 6 members/lop 26, 12/lop 27, 1/lop 24, so D1 is met (≤27). Residual, not a copy finding: aliases 's1, s2' give 29 at 6 members and 30 at 12, and 100/lop gives 28. No faithful shorter label exists ('имена:' still gives 28 at 6/'s1, s2'), so this is a layout issue.
